_note: The interface languages of Scrib: its own string catalogue, Scrib/Scrib/Localizable.xcstrings. Every announcement for Scrib must exist in every one. en-GB is served from en and needs no text of its own (see "aliases" in generate_announcements.py). Keep in step with that file: run tools/generate_announcements.py --check --app scrib --app-strings <that file>.
_languageFilterMinVersion: The first Scrib version that understands a post's `languages` field. Ship the build that adds the inbox as exactly this version (or change this value to match).
